verdict.rationale: Figma docs describe a natural-language 'Figma agent' for generating designs, diagrams, image edits, and file search, plus MCP-driven natural-language workflows (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-22), suggesting agentic/natural-language operation. However, hands-on community feedback specifically calls the AI tools 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), directly contradicting the polish implied by vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the core canvas agent's reliability (not just FigJam AI), and detailed examples of successful complex natural-language commands beyond marketing copy.
